summary: Completed end-to-end testing of AlokasiTransfer. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed covering suppliers CRUD (incl. denormalization sync + delete block when txs exist), transactions CRUD, settings GET/PUT, and recommendations structure/sorting. Frontend: Dashboard loads, KPI + calendar heatmap render correctly for Sept 2026 (Sept 8 amber 250jt, Sept 9 green 120jt), Smart Recommendations render 5 upcoming suggestions, Transaction dialog opens/prefills and successfully creates a new transaction on 2026-09-15 (visible on calendar), Daily Limit dialog updates limit, Supplier Manager successfully adds a supplier, calendar day click opens DayDetail, theme toggle button clickable.

issues: When suggestion total is 0, formatCompact returns '-' making the line read 'Terpakai - · Sisa kuota Rp 500.000.000' which is slightly confusing; consider 'Rp 0' or 'Belum dipakai'.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: replace '-' with 'Rp 0' in SmartRecommendations 'Terpakai' when total==0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes seed on startup with a public POST /api/seed (with force=true wipes all data) - acceptable for MVP but note the destructive endpoint is unauthenticated.
Recommendations endpoint fetches all transactions (up to 5000) and iterates twice per date - fine for MVP scale.
Denormalized supplier fields on transactions correctly synced on supplier update (verified in test).
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {"_id":0} in all list endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup with 4 suppliers and 3 transactions (Sept 8: 100jt+150jt, Sept 9: 120jt). Verified. Test-created data (TEST_ prefixed suppliers, 2026-09-15 tx) cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run with pytest. All 9 pass in ~2s. Frontend behavior verified via Playwright including calendar cells (data-testid calendar-day-cell-YYYY-MM-DD), TransactionDialog, DailyLimitDialog, SupplierManager. Environment date is 2026-09-08.
